One calculation functions (e.g. .calculate_or_curve()) — turn model predictor data frame points plot. server hands calculated curves shared make_general_plot() helper, every tab shares one consistent plotting style, legend behaviour, axis handling. job mostly produce right data frame. four steps: create module, wire UI, wire server, (optionally) add sidebar control panel.

title: Add your own tab and plots
text: Create R/mod_plot_myplot.R. skeleton mirrors built-modules — copying R/mod_plot_or.R adapting fastest way start. contracts respect: id must match plotMyPlotUI() plotMyPlotServer(), input IDs build shiny::NS(id, "predictor") UI must match input$predictor / populate_dropdown_predictors(id = "predictor") names server. server function signature takes selected_models, selected_reference_groups, model_definitions — reactive expressions supplied app_server(). selected_models() list models user checked; model_definitions() NULL algorithm loaded (handle case, ). calculation function returns named list — “curve data” — least df, x_axis_label, y_axis_label, title, x_axis_type, aes_args (mapping plot aesthetics columns df via rlang::sym()). make_general_plot() binds every model’s df together draws one curve per model. Optional fields subtitle also supported. Wrap render body plot_render_safely() computation error surfaces message plot area instead broken tab, call make_general_plot(NULL, ...) early algorithm loaded. Notes live outside values describe. value algorithm YAML file may carry free-text _notes_ (see Algorithm configuration reference). notes stripped model_definitions()$models collected model_definitions()$notes, model data calculation reads never _notes_/_value_ pair. show note next control, look get_notes(), passing keys lead value: key may also number, addressing value position rather name — way reach entries list, names : Positions 1-based work named values (list("models", 1) first model); mixed paths must list(), since c() coerce numbers names. get_notes() returns NULL key path exist notes attached.
code: #' My Custom Curve #' #' Functions for computing and rendering my custom curve. #' #' @name mod_plot_myplot #' @noRd #' @keywords internal NULL  # ---- Server ----------------------------------------------------------------  plotMyPlotServer <- function(   id,   selected_models,   selected_reference_groups,   model_definitions ) {   shiny::moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {     # Cache curve data so we don't recompute curves that haven't changed.     cached_curves <- initialize_cached_data()      shiny::observe(       {         model_definitions()          # react to a newly loaded algorithm         clear_cached_data(cached_curves)         populate_controls()       },       priority = 10000     )      populate_controls <- function() {       shiny::freezeReactiveValue(input, "predictor")       populate_dropdown_predictors(         session,         id = "predictor",         models = model_definitions()$models,         empty = is.null(model_definitions())       )     }      output$plot <- plotly::renderPlotly({       shiny::req(input$predictor)        if (is.null(model_definitions())) {         return(make_general_plot(NULL, model_definitions()))       }        plot_render_safely(function() {         all_curve_data <- list()         for (model_data in selected_models()) {           predictor_values <-             selected_reference_groups()[[model_data$model_id]]           all_curve_data[[length(all_curve_data) + 1]] <-             .calculate_myplot_curve(               input$predictor,               model_data,               reference_group = predictor_values             )         }         make_general_plot(all_curve_data, model_definitions())       })     })   }) }  # ---- Curve calculation -----------------------------------------------------  .calculate_myplot_curve <- function(   predictor,   model_data,   predictor_allowable_values = NULL,   reference_group = NULL ) {   predictor_allowable_values <- predictor_allowable_values %||%     model_data$predictor_allowable_values[[predictor]]   reference_group <- reference_group %||% model_data$reference_group    predictor_label <- get_variable_label_and_units(     model_data, predictor,     escape_html = TRUE   )    # Build an input matrix, run it through the model pipeline, and derive   # whatever quantity your curve plots. See .calculate_or_curve() in   # R/mod_plot_or.R for a worked example.   df <- data.frame(reference_group)   df <- df[rep(1, length(predictor_allowable_values)), ]   df[[predictor]] <- predictor_allowable_values   rownames(df) <- seq_len(nrow(df))    dat <- model.parameters.pipeline::run_model_pipeline(     model_data$model_pipeline,     x = df   )   predicted_col <- colnames(dat)[[1]]    output_df <- data.frame(     x = predictor_allowable_values,     MyValue = dat[[predicted_col]],     Model = cleanup_string(model_data$title)   )   names(output_df)[1] <- predictor_label   output_df <- convert_df_variable_to_label(     output_df, model_data, predictor, predictor_label,     escape_html = TRUE   )    # The named list below is the contract make_general_plot() expects.   list(     df = output_df,     x_axis_label = predictor_label,     y_axis_label = "My Value",     title = predictor_label,     x_axis_type = ifelse(       is_variable_categorical(model_data, predictor),       "Categorical",       "Continuous"     ),     aes_args = list(       x = rlang::sym(predictor_label),       y = rlang::sym("MyValue")     )   ) }  # ---- UI --------------------------------------------------------------------  plotMyPlotUI <- function(id, external_height) {   shiny::tagList(     shiny::br(),     plot_additional_controls_container(       plot_additional_controls_dropdown(         id = shiny::NS(id, "predictor"),         label = "Predictor",         choices = c(),         num_columns = 3       )     ),     plotly::plotlyOutput(       shiny::NS(id, "plot"),       height = glue::glue(         "calc(100vh - {external_height + plot_additional_controls_height()}px)"       )     )   ) } get_notes(   model_definitions(),   list("models", "male", "reference_group", "clc_age") ) get_notes(   model_definitions(),   list("models", "male", "predictor_allowable_values", "diabx", 2) )
